messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Jamal Carter, patient. 31, just moved to Lakeview from Columbus, impatient, changes his mind mid-call.
Facts:
- Name, DOB, destination 2250 Main St Lakeview [upfront]
- Old store is 'the Brightway on High Street' in Columbus (misremembered; really B-4471, 900 E Broad St) [only_if_asked]
- Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him) [only_if_asked]
- Phone 555-0177 [only_if_asked]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[turn 1] AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?
[turn 2] CALLER: Yeah, they're at Brightway still. Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[turn 2] AGENT: Got it. To request those from Brightway, I'll need to know which Brightway location has them—do you know the city or address?
[turn 3] CALLER: The sertraline, same thing. And the Brightway is on High Street, I think.
[turn 3] AGENT: Just to clarify—sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft, so that's the same medication, right? I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in our system. Do you remember what city that Brightway is in, or any cross streets nearby?
[turn 4] CALLER: Yeah, sertraline's the same thing, my bad. I don't know the exact address, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
[turn 4] AGENT: I can only search our system, which has Harbor Pharmacy locations. Brightway is a different pharmacy chain, so I don't have their store information. You'll need to contact Brightway in Columbus directly, or if you have your prescription numbers or bottles, that can help speed things up when you call them. Once they transfer the prescriptions to us, our team will receive them and get them ready for you here at the Main Street location.
[turn 5] CALLER: Alright, I'll dig up the number and call them myself. Thanks for the help.

JSON only.
